title: The Latest Crier for Apr 30, 2026
items:
Final Fling

Final Fling is this weekend—CAB’s end-of-year celebration and one last big hoorah on campus! You can check out the full schedule here , but here’s a quick overview of what’s happening: 

Friday 3–5 PM: Outdoor games & Lotus Bar on Gaass Lawn7–9 PM: Root Beer Keg Party & bonfire by the pond 

Saturday 6 AM–Noon: 50% off one drink at Smokey Row10 AM–Noon: FREE pickleball at West Side Social1–4 PM: Inflatables on Gaass Lawn2 PM: Live Mario Kart outside of Gaass 

Sunday 6:30–8:30 PM: Sustainabili-TEA with boba tea in the BMW Rooms (Maytag)
